name: eip4626-virtual-shares
description: ERC4626 vault WITH virtual shares protection — share inflation attack is infeasible
why_safe: The vault adds VIRTUAL_OFFSET (1000) to totalSupply() at all times. For a first-depositor attack to work, the attacker must donate more than VIRTUAL_OFFSET × deposit to move the share price meaningfully. This makes the attack economically irrational for any reasonable deposit size.

expected_verdict.reason: Virtual shares (VIRTUAL_OFFSET = 1000) make share inflation economically infeasible. Negative memory pattern FP-SEED-001 applies.
